text: Ujjivan started as a microfinance lender. Its own numbers say it's changing.
Group loans, its microfinance core, were thirty eight percent of the book a year ago. Now, thirty four.
Secured loans went from forty seven percent of the book to fifty two.
And bad loans fell, from two point four five percent to two point one, while write offs dropped from two hundred and thirteen crore to forty three.
A cleaner book, without writing off more. Is it still a microfinance bank? Back to the napkin.
